description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing test loading functionality for the Playwright testing framework, including functions for loading test files, managing test suites, and handling errors.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, used to organize and run tests.

methods.name: loadTestFile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a test file, creates a test suite, and manages dependencies and error handling.

methods.name: serializeLoadError
methods.description: Serializes an error encountered during test file loading into a TestError object.
